## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Include a synthetic reproduction or screenshot when useful.

## Validation

List relevant checks and their results. Identify UI evidence as local preview, MCP Apps harness, or native Codex. Include client/OS versions for native checks.

## Compatibility and data

Mention changes to recording formats, identifiers, limits, dependencies, or bundled notices. Do not attach private traces, credentials, bootstrap URLs, or unreviewed screenshots.
